title: Frame Break
summary: The video shrinks into a Reels/TikTok phone frame and the speaker pops out over its edge.
description: The full-frame shot springs down into a phone-shaped Reels (or TikTok) window floating on a dark, blurred copy of the footage. The window crops the shot just above the speaker's eyes, but the cut-out speaker is drawn on top, so their head breaks out over the top edge and their hands reach past the sides — a 3D pop-out. The feed chrome (like / comment / share rail, avatar, username, Follow pill, caption, progress bar) fades in once the window settles.

options.at: when the shot starts shrinking into the window (seconds or "@word")
options.outAt: optional: when it springs back to full screen (null = stays; it springs back automatically if the effect window ends before the clip)
options.platform: "reels" (Instagram) or "tiktok" — which feed chrome to draw
options.username: handle shown under the video (no @ needed)
options.caption: "auto" (first words of the transcript) or your own one-line caption
options.likes: like count under the heart ("" to hide)
options.comments: comment count under the bubble ("" to hide)
options.likeAt: optional: when the heart turns red (seconds or "@word"), null = never
options.ui: true to draw the feed chrome, false for a clean window
options.frameWidth: window width as a fraction of the frame width (0.5-0.75)
options.frameY: vertical centre of the window, 0-1 of the frame height
options.breakDepth: where the window's top edge cuts the head: 0 = top of the head (little pops out), 1 = middle of the face (more pops out)
options.sideBreak: how much wider than the window the footage is (1.0 = no side break, 1.12 = hands reach past the sides)
options.cornerRadius: window corner radius in px at 1080 wide
options.backdrop: "blur" (dark blurred copy of the footage), "dark" (charcoal gradient) or any CSS colour/gradient
options.shadow: soft drop shadow under the popped-out speaker (true/false)
options.sideFade: 0-0.15: fades the cut-out near the footage's left/right edges so a speaker who fills the frame doesn't end in a hard vertical line outside the window (0 = off)
